Once the gold has returned, no caller can tell which products were formed, and no caller can supply the squarings without computing the power itself. The gold's javadoc promises the fraction raised to a positive power, which 3/5 raised to 2 (9/25) is not when 3/5 comes back. The convention is pinned outside the gold: Fraction.multiplyBy is the product the gold is built on, and FractionTest testMultiply multiplies 6/10 by 6/10 to 9/25 and that by 6/10 to 27/125 (the square and the cube) and passes; Fraction.divideBy forms a quotient as the product with the reciprocal (testDivide), the convention hop 2 uses for a negative power; Fraction.invert gives the reciprocal unreduced (testInvert); the facade's javadoc states that the result is the fraction raised to the passed in power, in reduced form.
